nameOfQualification: AI and ML - Jr. Telecom Data Analyst
description: An AI and ML - Jr. Telecom Data Analyst supports the implementation of artificial intelligence solutions within telecom operations by collecting, organizing, and analyzing large-scale telecom datasets. The individual in this role assist in developing insights using AI/ML models to improve network performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
typeOfQualification: General, For ToT, For ToA, Future Skills

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Analyse Data using AI Tools and Utilize Data in Business Productivity
Clone-Support Implementation of AI Solutions in Telecom Operations
Organise Work and Resources as per Health and Safety Standards
Interact Effectively with Team Members and Customers

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.COMPLETEDSPECIALIZATION: Computer Science, IT, Electronics and Communication, Data Science/ AI and ML, Applied Statistics or Mathematics.

eligibilityCriteriaGrid.RELEVANTSPECIALIZATION: data handling, data annotation or labeling data validation, formatting, cleaning, or pattern identification), basic programming exposure (e.g., Python, SQL), experience working with telecom reports, customer logs, or usage data in support or MIS roles.
